highlights.title: Deserved it
highlights.text: Nick took over #1 in week 5 and never gave it back, backing up the power rank with the league's best record (11-2) and the actual championship — no playoff-luck asterisk this time.

highlights.title: All-time record
highlights.text: Triangle's 203.18 in week 2 is the single highest score across all 6 seasons now tracked on this site — yet they still finished as runner-up, not champion.

highlights.title: Bottom from day one
highlights.text: Pat sat in 10th place for 10 straight weeks, visible from week 1 onward, and finished the year 2-11 — dead last wire-to-wire.

highlights.title: 13 weeks, genuinely
highlights.text: This season really was 13 weeks, not a data gap — the weekly high-scorer pool paid out $455 instead of the usual $490.
